decisions.reason: LHD loaders are core to the firm's underground mining competence, and with no evidence of a shortfall against aspirations there is no trigger for problemistic search, so the established business's slack carries the line.

The construction site dumper builds on the firm's vehicle engineering and serves construction customers, but it was only mentioned rather than featured, so its results are uncertain and the risk of a drop is moderate, though slack allows continued trial.
The inclined furniture lift line had a dedicated page and fits the firm's lifting know-how, and absent evidence of falling below aspirations the firm would keep it while sales mature.
Inclined building material lifts link the firm's lifting and construction competences, are well presented, and have no shortfall signal, so they remain in the portfolio.

The truck-mounted furniture lift is a single niche model with uncertain demand, but it shares components with the lift line and costs little to carry, so the firm keeps it unless a clear shortfall prompts search.
